player_prompt.intro:
Ove iwe Muthimba {player_id} ukina omuthimba wa Checkers kamba {color}.
Ita omuthindo wove mu ndele ya chess [fileRank fileRank], e.g. '[b2c3]' (mbala ya koluna a–h, mbala ya muthindo 0–7).
Milayo ya kimbundi:
  • Enda ulalo mbele kwa 1 nge ove mwene.
  • Kopa kwa kuhunduka omutumbo wa muthimba wa kikwasha.
  • Omutumbo wa muthimba uka Mwene nge ufikelele komeko ya kule.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Kafwana mu ngolo lwa kukala. Lunda [a1b2], fano [b2c3].

outcome.red_no_pieces: Muthimba Mwekundu kina mutumbo muthindwa. Kikwasha ovuwa!
outcome.black_no_pieces: Kikwasha kina mutumbo muthindwa. Muthimba Mwekundu ovuwa!
